verses.1: And all the tribes of the Israelites set out from the land of China on their journey, according to Jehovah’s will. They stopped at Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.2: And the people grew more and more numerous with Moses. They said, “Give us water so that we can drink.” But Moses said to them, “What are you going to do when you stand before God? What will you prove to Him?”
verses.3: And there the people went into the water. The people lay down on Moses’ body, and they said, “Why have you brought us out of Egypt only to kill me, my children, and my possessions in this death?”
verses.4: And Moses cried out to the LORD, saying, “What shall I do for this people? They are still stubborn and hard-headed.”
verses.5: And the LORD said to Moses, “Go before the people. Take some of the elders of Israel with you. Choose a staff that you can hold in your hand, and then go.”
verses.6: I am standing before you there, on that rock. They stood on that rock, and water flowed out from it. The people drank from that water. Moses did this in front of the elders of Israel.
verses.7: And they named that place Masah and Merivah, because of the disputes among the Israelites and their battles against Jehovah. They said, “May Jehovah be with us, if only we don’t fail.”
verses.8: And Amalek came and fought against Israel at Rephidim.
verses.9: And Moses said to Joshua, “Choose some men for us, and go and fight against Amalek. After that, I will stand on the head of the hill, and I will hold the sword in my hand.”
verses.10: And Joshua did as Moses had commanded him: to fight against Amalek. Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of Mount Sinai.
verses.11: And it shall be when Moses lifts his hand and strikes Israel, and when he lays down his hand and strikes Amalek.
verses.12: Moses’ hands were covered with dust. They took stones and placed them under him, so that he could sit on them. Aaron and Hur held up Moses’ hands with their own hands. His hands remained stable until the sun went down.
verses.13: And Joshua defeated Amalek and his people at the Valley of Achor.
verses.14: And the LORD said to Moses, “Write this down as a reminder. Then place it in Jehovah’s ear, so that it will serve as a reminder of Amalek from beneath the heavens.”
verses.15: And Moses built a altar, and he called upon the name of Yahweh, “Nissi.”
verses.16: And he said, “Let there be a battle against Jahweh at Ammon, from the throne of his kingdom.”
